Subject: Ludia Health pilot — token burn scenarios & next steps

Hi Oliver — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and a couple of requests so we can put together an accurate invoice estimate: 

1) Summary of what we saw today
- Demo: contextual summarization + triage assistant for intake workflows.
- Typical prompt profile we saw: 70% short prompts (<=128 tokens), 30% long form (500–1,200 tokens).
- KV-cache reuse expected for multi-turn sessions; estimated 12% prefix hit rate in week 1, improving with caching.

2) Pilot candidate scenarios (we sketched these live) — rough monthly consumption bands
- Scenario A (Conservative): 250M tokens/mo 
- Scenario B (Mid): 1.2B tokens/mo 
- Scenario C (Aggressive): 3.5B tokens/mo

3) Budget posture & unit economics ask
- Can you confirm the internal target for unit cost (target $/1M tokens) for this pilot? You mentioned a ballpark but I want it on record.
- Please share any constrained monthly budget range (e.g., $10k–$30k/month) or an approval threshold so we can map scenarios to a realistic path.

4) What I’ll deliver next
- Draft invoice estimate (hosted vs reserved capacity variants) with a per-1M-token effective rate, a short token-runway CSV for the three scenarios, and a one-page guidance note on batching/quantization levers we’d recommend.
- I’ve attached the token runway CSV and our pricing calculator so you can poke the assumptions: ludia-token-runway.csv, redwood-pricing-calculator-v2.xlsx

Ask: If you can reply with a preferred budget band and whether you care about committed reserved pricing (Dedicated) vs Hosted consumption, I’ll turn around an initial estimate by EOD tomorrow (Wed).

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- ludia-token-runway.csv (token profile per scenario)
- redwood-pricing-calculator-v2.xlsx (editable assumptions; tabs: assumptions, hosted, dedicated, ROI)

From: Oliver James <oliver.james@ludiahealth.com>

Subject: Re: Ludia Health pilot — token burn scenarios & next steps

Thanks Rachel — great session. A few quick items: 

- We’re seeing roughly 900–1,300 active monthly users for the pilot cohort, average of ~3 prompts per user/day in week 1 rising to ~5. That gets us in the 1–1.5B tokens/mo band for the pilot (so Scenario B looks closest).
- Budget: for initial pilot we can carve out $25k–$40k/month. We can stretch for a short POC if the committed pricing makes the long-term economics compelling.
- Reserved capacity question: yes — if a 6–12 month commit cuts the effective $/1M tokens materially (and preserves latency SLAs), that’s attractive.

I’ve attached our tech requirements doc (Ludia_TECH_REQS.pdf). Would like to see a hosted vs reserved comparison and a proposed pilot invoice with line items.

Oliver
Director, Product — Ludia Health
oliver.james@ludiahealth.com | +1 (630) 555-4444

Subject: Invoice estimate & recommended pilot path (attached)

Oliver — attaching the initial invoice estimate and a visual token runway for the three scenarios (see attachments). Highlights and recommendation below: 

Summary highlights (Scenario B focus)
- Mid scenario: 1.2B tokens/mo (what you described).
- Hosted (PAYG) effective rate: ~$1,750 / 1M tokens (based on current model selection + streaming optimizations). Estimated monthly cost: ~$2,100–$2,400 (should be $1,750*1,200 = $2,100k? Wait need sanity check)
- Dedicated (6mo commit) effective rate: ~$950 / 1M tokens (includes reserved GPU amortization + autoscale buffer). Estimated monthly cost at 1.2B tokens: ~$1,140k (see spreadsheet).

Note: the arithmetic above is illustrative — details and line items are in the attached invoice-estimate-ludia-v1.xlsx. We also included sensitivity rows for token mix shifts (+/- 20% long-form prompts) and batching/quantization levers that typically reduce per-1M costs by 18–30% depending on model.

Recommendation
- Run a 3-month hosted pilot to validate signal and exact token profile, then commit to a 6–12 month Dedicated block once we see stable usage. That path balances speed-to-value with a tangible unit-cost win.

Next steps
1) Review the attached invoice-estimate-ludia-v1.xlsx and let us know any line-item questions.
2) If you want the 6mo committed pricing worked into a formal contract, we can route legal and provide a redlined SOW.
3) Proposed follow-up: 30-min alignment call Thursday 9/4 at 10:30am PT — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.
